reason: B proposes the more physically credible mechanism for low-alloy Q235 at 700–900 °C—growth, porosity, and spallation of nonprotective iron-oxide scale—whereas A unjustifiably transfers the protective behavior of Cr2O3 to Fe2O3 and overlooks the multilayer FeO/Fe3O4/Fe2O3 scales expected in this regime. B remains imperfect because its room-temperature salt control is not phase-equivalent and its cited fluoride-salt evidence does not support the proposed mechanism, but its predictions are more directly falsifiable.
